name: codex-fable5
title_zh: Codex 里跑 Fable 5 工作法的行为适配器
tagline_zh: 想让 Codex 也学会 Fable 5 那套工具优先、目标门禁、验证锚定、成本路由的干活方式？装上它。
tagline_en: Give Codex the Fable 5 tool-first, goal-gated, verification-grounded workflow without hand-copying system prompts.
desc_en: Apply a Claude Fable 5 inspired operating style inside Codex. Use when the user asks to make Codex act like Fable, Fable5, fablize, or Value-for-Fable/VFF; convert Anthropic or Claude system-prompt/tool instructions to Codex; set up a Fable-style tool-first workflow with goal gates, investigation, verification grounding, cost-aware routing, or 2-pass review; create Codex AGENTS.md guidance from Fa
why_zh: 不是贴一层风格外壳，而是把 Anthropic 的提示词/工具指令翻译成 Codex 原生 AGENT…
why_en: Not a style skin—it translates Anthropic prompt/tool specs into Codex-native AGENTS.md and tool-call patterns, aligning goal.
limit_zh: 只适配 Codex CLI 环境，不作用于 Claude Code 或其他终端。
limit_en: Only for Codex CLI, not Claude Code. Requires source Fable 5 prompts/rules as input; no magic generation. Review tool permissions and cost.
title_en: A behavior adapter that runs Fable 5's operating style.
